note: one 10-day OPDI file (flight_events_20250105_20250115, 233 MB) measured before committing to ~9 GB
matching: label-free: same airport and callsign, OPDI parking exit 0-60 min before the take-off time

fallback_lane.finding: the rows that most need a physical off-block are the ones physical tracking cannot see, the same wall the ADS-B work hit (7 fallback rows on its day)

official_value.why_the_earlier_estimate_was_high: it assumed the model scored 226 s on the covered rows; measured, the model scores 142.8 s there because OPDI covers our EASIEST airports, so there is far less to remove

verdict: NOT WORTH BUILDING. OPDI carries genuinely independent information (error correlation only 0.235, and 7.74 s of gain on LSZH rows), but it covers the rows we already predict well and cannot see the rows we predict badly. About 0.14 s for ~9 GB, a second data pipeline and coverage that migrates between years (EDDF had 2 events in Jan-2025 and 4,399 in Jan-2026).
one_correction_to_the_record: LSZH coverage is 67.7 %, not the 20 % recorded on 06.09; the earlier figure came from callsign matching without the ICAO normalisation.
